en: Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a rural settlement in front of steep, rounded limestone hills. In the foreground are cultivated fields and dense banana or similar tropical plants with a thatched hut. Farther back stand several small houses, some with thatched roofs and some with tiled roofs, forming a village. Laundry or cloth hangs on a line at the right, and the dramatic rocky hills rise vertically behind the settlement. A small number "542" appears at the lower left margin and "03211.0001" at the lower right border.
